name: 619 Spirits North Park
tagline: USA Today's top 10 ranked craft vodka distillery is expanding in San Diego
description: 619 Spirits is an award-winning craft distillery and kitchen located in San Diego's North Park neighborhood. Known for its premium, small-batch infusions, the company is currently expanding into a new 8,000 square foot distillery and event space. They offer a unique investment opportunity with a 1.8x return multiple as they scale their local production and hospitality footprint.

founders.name: Nick Apostolopoulos
founders.bio: Founder of 619 Spirits with over a decade of experience in the San Diego craft spirits market, focused on natural and local ingredient infusions.

updates.title: Expansion Update
updates.body: Development of the new 8,000 sqft distillery and event space is underway, aiming to capitalize on their top 10 national ranking.

highlights: USA Today Top 10 Ranked Craft Vodka Distillery
Expanding into a new 8,000 sqft flagship facility
Offering a 1.8x investment return multiple
Highly established brand in the San Diego market

name: ISD Pal Inc
tagline: Fixing corporate training with research-based AI solutions
description: Nuralia is an AI-powered platform designed to revolutionize corporate learning and development by keeping pace with rapid organizational change. Founded by an Inc. 5000 entrepreneur and PwC alum, the company utilizes research-backed methodologies to optimize workforce training. The platform addresses the critical gap in traditional corporate educational tools through intelligent automation.

founders.name: Houri Tamizifar
founders.bio: 2x Founder who previously scaled Cynuria to the Inc. 5000. Former PwC and Booz Allen consultant with 20+ years of L&D expertise.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Successfully reached 77% of current funding goal within the initial phase of the Wefunder campaign.

highlights: Founded by Inc. 5000 serial entrepreneur
Addressing a massive $300B+ corporate training market
Backed by deep L&D expertise from PwC and Booz Allen
Proprietary AI research-based methodology

name: CareNgen
description: CareNgen is a comprehensive digital platform focused on senior life planning and elder care solutions. The company provides validated, user-friendly tools to help families navigate the complexities of aging, from healthcare management to financial logistics. Launching with strategic bank partners, CareNgen aims to provide a centralized ecosystem for the rapidly growing aging population.

founders.name: Jennifer Redding
founders.bio: Experienced healthcare leader focused on aging-in-place solutions and senior care technology.

updates.title: Market Launch
updates.body: Transitioned from MVP to market with validated user feedback and established banking partnerships.

highlights: Over $950,000 in past funding secured
Strategic launch partnership with a regional bank
Addresses critical 'Silver Tsunami' market needs
Repeat founder and notable angel investor backing

name: Blue Dot Motorworks
tagline: Convert gas vehicles into plug-in hybrids quickly and affordably
description: Blue Dot Motorworks is a clean technology company developing innovative hardware that converts internal combustion engines into high-efficiency plug-in hybrids. Their patent-pending technology allows vehicle owners to significantly reduce emissions and fuel costs without the expense of purchasing a new EV. The system is designed for rapid installation and a short payback period for consumers.

founders.name: Tom Gurski
founders.bio: MIT-trained engineer and serial entrepreneur with 25 years of experience in alternative energy and e-mobility.

updates.title: Hardware Development Milestone
updates.body: Achieved significant testing benchmarks showing a potential $50,000 lifetime savings per converted vehicle.

highlights: MIT-engineered retrofit technology
Estimated lifetime savings of $50,000 per vehicle
Product pays for itself in under 2 years
Large-scale environmental impact potential for existing fleets

name: Tripmix
tagline: Make any travel content shoppable with AI
description: Tripmix is an AI-powered social travel marketplace that transforms static travel content into interactive, shoppable experiences. By bridging the gap between social media inspiration and actual booking, Tripmix allows creators to monetize their journeys and travelers to book trips instantly. The platform is built by repeat SaaS founders and is currently seeing early organic growth.

founders.name: Rajiv Chopra
founders.bio: 2x Founder with a successful SaaS fintech exit. Early investor in AI automation and pioneer in travel creator technology.

updates.title: Early Revenue Milestone
updates.body: Successfully launched the AI marketplace and recorded initial revenue from organic travel creator integrations.

highlights: Led by a 2x founder with a prior fintech exit
First AI & low-code platform for travel creators
Organic growth in the booming travel social commerce space
San Francisco-based tech with global applicability
